verdict.rationale: Dover is a SaaS ATS with a public API, so issuing scoped, least-privilege credentials for an agent is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows that an API exists (add candidates, list hires). Nothing documents API keys, permission scopes, or per-agent credential restrictions, and the OpenAPI probes returned 404, so there is no scope schema to inspect.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
